```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)

project_root <- params$project_root
db_root <- ""
db_path <- params$db_path
if (!is.null(db_path) && nzchar(trimws(db_path))) {
  db_candidate <- tryCatch(normalizePath(db_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) "")
  if (nzchar(db_candidate)) {
    db_root <- dirname(dirname(db_candidate))
  }
}
root_candidates <- c(
  if (!is.null(project_root)) project_root else "",
  db_root,
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""),
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "../..")
)
root_candidates <- unique(root_candidates[nzchar(root_candidates)])
root_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate in root_candidates) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R"))) {
    root_dir <- candidate
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(root_dir)) stop("Unable to locate project root for report helpers.")

apply_theme <- isTRUE(params$apply_theme)

parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  dbExecute(con, "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lists")
  tbls <- c("Sample_Hierarchy")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
  list_file <- file.path(parquet_dir, "lists_MasterSiteUnitList.parquet")
  if (file.exists(list_file)) {
    dbExecute(
      con,
      sprintf("CREATE TABLE VLists.MasterSiteUnitList AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", gsub("'", "''", list_file))
    )
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
  lists_db <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "vpro_lists.duckdb")
  if (file.exists(lists_db)) {
    lists_db_norm <- normalizePath(lists_db, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
    dbExecute(con, sprintf("ATTACH '%s' AS lists", gsub("'", "''", lists_db_norm)))
  }
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
hier <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM Sample_Hierarchy")
long_names <- data.frame()
if (DBI::dbExistsTable(con, "VLists.MasterSiteUnitList")) {
  long_names <- dbGetQuery(
    con,
    "SELECT SiteSeries, SiteSeriesLongName FROM VLists.MasterSiteUnitList"
  )
}
normalize_hier_cols <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  cols <- names(df)
  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- which(tolower(cols) %in% tolower(candidates))
    if (length(idx) > 0) cols[[idx[1]]] else NA_character_
  }
  id_col <- pick_col(c("id", "ID"))
  name_col <- pick_col(c("name", "Name", "_name"))
  parent_col <- pick_col(c("parent", "Parent"))
  level_col <- pick_col(c("level", "Level"))
  tag_col <- pick_col(c("tag", "Tag"))
  if (!is.na(id_col)) df$ID <- df[[id_col]]
  if (!is.na(name_col)) df$Name <- df[[name_col]]
  if (!is.na(parent_col)) df$Parent <- df[[parent_col]]
  if (!is.na(level_col)) df$Level <- df[[level_col]]
  if (!is.na(tag_col)) df$Tag <- df[[tag_col]]
  df
}

hier <- normalize_hier_cols(hier)
cutoff_level <- params$cutoff_level
if (!is.null(cutoff_level) && !is.na(cutoff_level) && ("Level" %in% names(hier))) {
  hier <- hier[hier$Level <= cutoff_level, , drop = FALSE]
}
dbDisconnect(con)

if (nrow(long_names) > 0) {
  names(long_names) <- tolower(names(long_names))
  names(long_names)[names(long_names) == "siteseries"] <- "name_key"
  names(long_names)[names(long_names) == "siteserieslongname"] <- "long_name"
  long_names$name_key <- as.character(long_names$name_key)
  hier$Name <- as.character(hier$Name)
  hier <- dplyr::left_join(hier, long_names[, c("name_key", "long_name")], by = c("Name" = "name_key"))
}

if (!("long_name" %in% names(hier))) {
  hier$long_name <- NA_character_
}

hier$long_name <- ifelse(is.na(hier$long_name), "No long name", hier$long_name)
hier$Tag <- ifelse(is.na(hier$Tag), "", as.character(hier$Tag))
hier$Name <- as.character(hier$Name)
hier <- hier[!grepl("\\?$", hier$Name), , drop = FALSE]

tag_to_color <- function(tag) {
  tag <- if (is.null(tag) || length(tag) == 0 || is.na(tag)) "" else as.character(tag[[1]])
  tag <- tolower(trimws(tag))
  if (tag == "yellow") return("#f9e27d")
  if (tag == "blue") return("#9db8d8")
  if (tag == "green") return("#b5d6a7")
  if (tag == "red") return("#f4a6a0")
  if (tag == "orange") return("#f7c59d")
  ""
}

format_node_label <- function(row) {
  label <- paste0(row$Name, " : ", row$long_name)
  color <- tag_to_color(row$Tag)
  if (apply_theme && nzchar(color)) {
    paste0("<span style=\"background-color:", color, "; padding:2px 4px; border-radius:2px;\">", label, "</span>")
  } else {
    label
  }
}

build_tree_html <- function(df, parent_id = NA_integer_, visited = character(), max_depth = 50, level = 0) {
  if (level > max_depth) return(character())
  if (nrow(df) == 0 || !("ID" %in% names(df))) return(character())

  parent_vals <- df$Parent
  match_parent <- if (is.na(parent_id)) {
    is.na(parent_vals)
  } else {
    parent_vals == parent_id
  }

  roots <- df[match_parent, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(roots) == 0) return(character())
  roots <- roots[order(roots$Name), , drop = FALSE]

  lines <- character()
  lines <- c(lines, "<ul>")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(roots))) {
    row <- roots[i, ]
    row_id <- as.character(row$ID)
    if (row_id %in% visited) next
    lines <- c(lines, paste0("<li>", format_node_label(row)))
    child_lines <- build_tree_html(df, row$ID, c(visited, row_id), max_depth, level + 1)
    if (length(child_lines) > 0) lines <- c(lines, child_lines)
    lines <- c(lines, "</li>")
  }
  lines <- c(lines, "</ul>")
  lines
}
```

# `r params$report_title`

Lowest level: `r params$cutoff_level`

```{r hierarchy-tree, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(hier) > 0) {
  cat(paste(build_tree_html(hier), collapse = "\n"))
} else {
  cat("No hierarchy records found.")
}
```
